To:
housing@prairieu.edu
From:
mlee20@prairieu.edu
Sent:
October 25, 2025, 8:12 P.M.
Subject:
Mediation options
Dear Housing Office,
I’m writing about ongoing tension with my roommate in Matthis Hall,
Room 318. We disagree on quiet hours and guests, and lately our
conversations have started feeling heated. We tried setting a schedule,
but it hasn’t stuck. I don’t want this to escalate, and I’d prefer a solution
that keeps us both in the room.
Could you explain the mediation process? Do you offer conflict
resolution sessions with a resident advisor or professional staff, and
are meeting notes kept confidential? If we need a temporary room
change during exams, how does that work?
I’m available most weekdays after 4 P.M. I appreciate the work your
team does to support a healthy living environment, and I want to
resolve this respectfully.
Thank you,
Marcus Lee
